prompt.text: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art sprite concept for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: a single URCHIN enemy of the Iron Tide, a small squat reef turret bolted to the seabed of a nebula sea. A low charcoal barnacle dome armored in overlapping slate-gray scales like a pinecone, crowned with a radiating fan of seven sharp purple crystal spines with bright lilac tips, longest at the top. On the dome's left-facing front a single round glowing magenta aiming lens with a white-hot pinpoint center and a dark iris ring stares forward. The dome sits on a small flat chunk of warm sandstone reef rock in pale tan and peach with a few tiny pores. Squat, wide, spiky, unmistakable silhouette. Side view facing left, centered with a generous empty margin on a perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background. Crisp chunky pixel art with a 1-pixel near-black navy outline at the sprite's native pixel scale, flat saturated fills with three-step shading ramps lit from the top-left, bold simple shape that stays readable at small size, no anti-aliasing, no seaweed, no scenery, no stars, no cast shadow, no glow bleeding onto the background, no text, no labels.
prompt.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, labels, numbers, watermark, blurry, anti-aliasing, gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, green tint on the subject, green spill, multiple creatures, sprite sheet grid, perspective distortion
